runewords.name: Ancient's Pledge
runewords.uses: One slot solves the entire resistance sheet — and adds a real damage multiplier plus DR. Strong for casters, shield users, hardcore.

runewords.name: Call to Arms
effects: Power: while affected by a Shout — +5 ranks to all Skills, +15% Maximum Life, +15%[x] Maximum Primary Resource
runewords.uses: Barbarian Shout builds (effectively +10 Shout ranks). Off-hand pairing for buff uptime; flat attack speed for anyone.

runewords.name: Edge
effects: Inherent +7.5% extra item chance from Purveyor of Curiosities
Lucky Hit: up to 40% chance +[1,100–1,600] Poisoning damage over 10s
runewords.uses: Gambling utility — equip while dumping Obols. Also thorns builds.

runewords.name: Enigma
effects: Power: your Evade is now Sorcerer's Teleport, costs 33 Primary Resource
runewords.uses: Universal chase item. Evade→Teleport on every class; pair with evade-cooldown resets for permanent teleport rotation.

runewords.name: Grief
effects: Power: direct damage inflicts 40% bonus Poisoning damage over 5s
runewords.uses: Flat weapon damage can double a one-hander's swing. Shield-pairing melee, Rampage Barb speed farm, poison Rogue.

runewords.name: Holy Thunder
effects: Power: you emit Crackling Energy; enemies damaged by it take [20–35]%[x] increased Holy/Fire/Lightning/Physical damage from you for 3s
runewords.uses: Multi-element amplifier — mult + elemental debuff ≈ ×100 combined.

runewords.name: Infinity
effects: Lucky Hit: up to 20% chance to deliver a Crushing Blow
Power: 50% chance Rank 10 Chain Lightning on kill
Power: close enemies are Vulnerable, take +62.5%[x] damage from you
runewords.uses: Speed/gold farming and melee-range casters. Crushing Blow scales against Pit boss HP pools.

runewords.name: Insight
runewords.uses: Crit stick — crit chance + ×100 crit-damage mult can solo-solve crit and combos with crit-splinter tradeoffs. Not staff-only: bows, glaives, polearms etc.

runewords.name: King's Grace
runewords.uses: +50% Lucky Hit can carry lucky-hit builds; ×75 mult approaches ~×150 with masterwork.

runewords.name: Leaf
effects: Possibly bugged: missing its D2 fire-skills identity (community report)|?
runewords.uses: Resource-focused early leveling staff, currently weakest of the set.

runewords.name: Pattern
effects: Lucky Hit: up to 40% chance +[1,100–1,600] Poisoning damage over 10s
runewords.uses: Defensive Rogue / poison off-hand; crit roll can solve crit in one slot.

runewords.name: Phoenix
effects: Lucky Hit: up to 40% chance +1,500 Fire Damage
Power: Rank 40 Ring of Fire on level-up
Lucky Hit: up to [15–30]% chance Rank 22 Fire Spear
Shield variant: +35% Fire Resistance, 10% Damage Reduction instead of the multiplier|?
runewords.uses: Fire builds; dual-wield deadly-strike stacking to skip crit via splinters.

runewords.name: Prudence
runewords.uses: Pure defense — hardcore, tanks; no offense.

runewords.name: Rain
effects: Power: Lucky Hit [15–30]% chance Rank 15 Tornado
Power: 50% chance Rank 15 Cyclone Armor on Dodge
runewords.uses: Druid Nature Magic — Tornado/Storm setups; dodge procs tighten packs.

runewords.name: Spirit
effects: Shield variant swaps the multiplier for Maximum Life|?
runewords.uses: Usable from level 25, ten base types — near-universal damage weapon for casters and resource builds.

runewords.name: Stealth
runewords.uses: Best leveling craft — reportedly free base + Tal + Eth from the seasonal quest (unconfirmed). Does NOT grant Teleport (in-game tested).

runewords.name: Strength
effects: Lucky Hit: up to 25% chance to deliver a Crushing Blow
runewords.uses: Cheap filler melee weapon; Crushing Blow shines vs tanky bosses.

runewords.name: Zephyr
effects: Lucky Hit: up to 40% chance +1,500 Lightning Damage
Power: unleash a Dust Devil whenever you Dodge
runewords.uses: Rogue leveling bow — craft on first Ort + Eth.

craft: Get a white (Common) base item of a valid type — the base's Item Power carries over to the result, so use high-IP bases for expensive recipes.
Open the Horadric Cube (requires the Lord of Hatred campaign) and place the base + runes in the listed order (order is reported to matter — disputed).
Press Transmute; unknown valid combos preview as ??? before crafting.
notes: Result is a Unique: enchanting OK (single source), tempering NOT possible, masterworking unconfirmed.
Every recipe exists as a normal and an ancestral version — ancestral ≈ 2× values. Stats on this page are normal-tier.
Salvaging may return the runes (single source, unconfirmed).
Seasonal quest reportedly grants a chest base + Tal + Eth early (unconfirmed).
Class access is governed by the base item — Spiritborn is excluded from most 1H recipes but can use armor and 2H recipes.
Datamined from patch 3.2.1 client data; several values not yet verified in-game. Blizzard never documented the system — found by players (Dioxide first).
